name: Root CA trust store modification (Linux)
description: A certificate added to the system trust store (T1553.004): a new file under a CA anchor directory, or an update-ca-certificates/update-ca-trust run. update-ca-certificates is a shell script so it is matched on the command line, not the executable.
query: any where host.os.type == "linux" and ((event.category == "file" and event.action in ("creation", "rename") and file.path like ("/usr/local/share/ca-certificates/*", "/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/*", "/usr/share/ca-certificates/*")) or (event.category == "process" and event.type == "start" and process.command_line like ("*update-ca-certificates*", "*update-ca-trust*", "*trust anchor*")))
